messages:
Joon (Docs): FYI opening PR to add a compatibility matrix row for zephyr-mini-4b in the model catalog. Need quick check on supported runtimes and quant variants.

Ravi (ML): Zephyr-mini-4b officially supports runtime v2.3+ and has two quant builds: q4_0 and q8_0. Note q4_0 has degraded perf on long sequences.

Tara (SDK): The example snippets currently call model: 'zephyr-mini' — we should use the canonical slug 'zephyr-mini-4b' to avoid ambiguity. I'll update SDK examples in the PR.

Lina (Eng): Also add a note about streaming: zephyr-mini-4b doesn't support token streaming with the v2 runtime due to async kernel constraints. We should mark "streaming: false" in the card.

Joon (Docs): Good catch. I'll add fields: supported_runtimes: ["v2.3+"], quant_variants: ["q4_0","q8_0"], streaming: false, sequence_limit: 4096 and a short bench note about throughput on q8_0.

DocBot: PR #4210 lint: model card requires an examples section and at least one SDK snippet for Python or Node.

Tara (SDK): I'll add both Node and Python quickstarts. Node snippet will use client.generate with system+user messages; Python will show embed+generate combo.

Ravi (ML): Add a small compatibility caveat: q4_0 may return lower-quality completion tokens on highly repetitive prompts; recommend q8_0 for production chat.

Lina (Eng): Also request that infra add a deprecation alias so older links to /models/zephyr-mini map to /catalog/models/zephyr-mini-4b. Filed infra-redirects#44.

Joon (Docs): Thanks — I'll land the PR after infra confirms redirect. Please review the snippets for accuracy once I push.

Lina (Eng): Redirect is live.

Joon (Docs): CI green, merged PR #4210. Closing thread.
